# Fuchs, De historia stirpium (1542)

Woodcut plant portraits from the 1542 Basel edition of Leonhart Fuchs's herbal De historia stirpium commentarii insignes, scanned by the Universitätsbibliothek Basel (shelfmark UBH Lo I 4) on e-rara.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `fuchs-1542-herbal`, historical, 7 assets, version 1.0.0.
